mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This sandwich contains a whole grain oat bread base with protein and vegetables, which provides moderate glycemic impact for someone with diabetes. It is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for a sandwich with whole grain bread and additional high-fiber vegetables instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_title: Oat Bread Sandwich with Chicken, Pickles, and Lettuce
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A sandwich made with oat bread, containing chicken breast, pickles, and lettuce.
